description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenCdmSessionPrivate class, which manages DRM sessions in a media playback context. It uses Google Test framework to verify behaviors such as initialization, license request handling, session management, and metadata addition, with mock dependencies for backend interactions and callbacks.

classes.name: OpenCdmSessionTests
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing OpenCdmSessionPrivate behaviors using Google Test framework.

methods.name: createSut
methods.description: Creates an instance of OpenCDMSessionPrivate with specified license type.

methods.name: createInvalidSut
methods.description: Creates an instance of OpenCDMSessionPrivate with null backend and dispatcher to test invalid scenarios.

methods.name: initializeSut
methods.description: Initializes the session, setting up backend and dispatcher mocks.

methods.name: requestLicense
methods.description: Simulates a license request by invoking the callback.

methods.name: updateKeyStatus
methods.description: Updates the key status and triggers corresponding callbacks.

methods.name: fillBuffers
methods.description: Allocates and fills GstBuffers with test data.

methods.name: verifyMetadata
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of protection metadata added to a GstBuffer.

methods.name: addGstProtectionMeta
methods.description: Adds a GstProtectionMeta to a GstBuffer with test data.
